page.overview:
Who is Kimberly Hart?

Kimberly Ann Hart was the first Mighty Morphin' Pink Ranger, empowered by the Pterodactyl Power Coin.

Kim was a typical student at Angel Grove High School and an aspiring professional gymnast. Her life became a lot more complicated when she was chosen alongside classmates Jason Lee Scott, Zack Taylor, Trini Kwan, and Billy Cranston to become the Power Rangers. Tasked with fighting the minions of the evil Rita Repulsa, the Rangers do their best to balance their school lives with this new world of evil space aliens and powers.

Following his restoration from Rita's spell, Kim started a relationship with the new Green Ranger, Tommy Oliver.

With Tommy missing and incommunicado, Kim expresses her worries with Alpha 5 and Zordon.
